# zerops_project (Resource)

A Zerops project. Credit limits are retained in state because the API cannot read them; removing configuration does not clear a cap. An externally DELETING project is forgotten before purge finishes, so recreation may overlap deletion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerops_project" "example" {
  name               = "example"
  description        = "Managed by Terraform"
  tags               = ["terraform"]
  mode               = "LIGHT"
  env_isolation      = "none"
  ssh_isolation      = "vpn"
  public_ipv4_shared = false

  # The API cannot read a configured cap. Removing this attribute retains it.
  max_credit_limit = "25"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name (not unique).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description; omission clears it.
- `env_isolation` (String) Environment isolation tokens; defaults to server settings.
- `location` (String) Location catalog ID; defaults to server location.
- `max_credit_limit` (String) Positive decimal credit cap. Unreadable remotely, retained in Terraform state, and cannot be cleared after being set.
- `mode` (String) LIGHT or SERIOUS. Upgrades happen in place; downgrades replace the project.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider organization.
- `public_ipv4_shared` (Boolean) Enable shared public IPv4.
- `ssh_isolation` (String) SSH isolation tokens; defaults to server settings.
- `tags` (Set of String) Project tags.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation time in RFC3339 format.
- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `public_ipv4` (String) Public IPv4, if allocated.
- `public_ipv6` (String) Public IPv6, if allocated.
- `status` (String) Raw project status.
- `zerops_subdomain_host` (String) Zerops project subdomain host.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zerops_project.example '<project_id>'
```
